versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Moths brew Phials, spells in your hand that grow each turn you hold them.
Cast them now to count up your Recipe, or hold and merge them into one huge Phial that spills across your board.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Settled the rules questions: The Alchymist's counted Echoes now set off The Old Lady, Dame Pavonia can take Echoes, and Cocoon Spinner says what happens with no Phial.
Also: Pestle Grinder gives a Phial 1 so it does something early, golden Herald reaches 8, and Elder says how to get an N 8 Phial.

stop_reason: 3 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
